text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Lanterra Developments Limited is constructing a 26-storey and 53-storey building at 501 Yonge Street, with frontage on Maitland Street and Alexander Street, respectively. The south sidewalk and a portion of the westbound lane on Maitland Street and the north sidewalk and a portion of the eastbound lane on Alexander Street, fronting the site are currently closed to accommodate construction staging operations for the development. Toronto and East York Committee Council, at its meeting on April 5, 2016, approved the subject construction staging areas on Alexander Street and Maitland Street, from April 13, 2017 to June 30, 2019. The developer has requested an extension of the duration of the construction…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the continuation of the closure of the sidewalk and the curb lane on the south side of Maitland Street, between Yonge Street and a point 63.6 metres east, from July 1, 2019 to September 30, 2020. 2. Approved the continuation of the closure of the sidewalk and the curb lane on the north side of Alexander Street, between Yonge Street and a point 67.4 metres east, from July 1, 2019 to June 31, 2021. 3. Directed the applicant to continue posting a 24-hour monitored construction hotline number on the hoarding board, which must be prominently placed and legible from 20 metres and on all elevations from the construction site. 4.
